issues: Broken/scrambled structure: stray page-number markers like "4 -", "5 -", "8 -", "9 -" and an in-line "- 6 -" / "- 7 -" appear in the translated text; these are not part of the legal text and disrupt list items (especially items 13 and 17).

Meaning drift/grammar affecting legal clarity in item 12: sentence break/capitalization renders "any act..." as a separate fragment; should be integrated as in the original definition. Minor meaning/term issues: item 23 should be singular "Service" (Pelayanan), and item 25 "victim citizens" is an incorrect rendering of "warga korban" (should be "victims"/"affected residents").

Meaning drift: Item 12 mistranslates/garbles the definition of Violence Against Women; the Indonesian text lists types of suffering (physical, psychological, sexual, economic, social, and discrimination) and then separately defines gender-based acts causing physical/sexual/psychological suffering; the English adds/reshuffles categories (e.g., 'socially, economically and discrimination') and loses the structure/meaning.

Meaning drift: Item 25 adds meaning by translating "warga korban" as "affected residents"; it should be "victim residents"/"community members who are victims" (i.e., residents who are victims), not merely affected residents.
Scrambled numbering/list structure in Article 3: item (3) is merged into item 2 and the marker '(3)' is missing as a separate list item; several lettered subitems are run together (e.g., 'and i.').

Scrambled numbering/list structure in Article 4: markers (3) and (4) are embedded mid-paragraph instead of appearing as separate numbered items; lettered subitems are also run together (e.g., 'andc.', 'andj.').

Scrambled numbering/list structure in Article 5: markers (3) and (4) are embedded after '15 -' instead of appearing as separate numbered items; some lettered subitems are run together (e.g., 'andg.').

Broken/scrambled list structure: several list markers are concatenated with preceding text (e.g., 'include:a.', 'andf.', 'victim:b.', 'minimum:a.', 'include:a.', 'andc.', 'andg.', 'by:a.', 'media; f.', 'andq.', etc.), which can break downstream boundary splitting.
Heading/list boundary issue: 'Article 8' is not presented as its own heading/marker as in the original ('Pasal 8'); it is merged into the preceding line under '## Part Two'.
Meaning drift/term inconsistency: 'KBGO' is rendered as 'GBOV' without basis in the source; the acronym should be preserved as 'KBGO' (or expanded), but not changed to a different acronym.

Broken Markdown/list structure: in the original, the Article 8 heading is embedded in the same line as the Part Two title ("... Diskriminasi PasaI 8"), but the translation introduces a new heading "#### Article 8"; headings must match the original structure exactly.

Scrambled numbering marker: Article 6 paragraph (2) is preceded by stray page/line marker "16 -" and rendered as "16 - (2)" instead of keeping the list marker "(2)" aligned with the article’s numbering structure (the original has "16 - (2)" as a page marker plus paragraph marker).

Scrambled/merged list markers: several lettered sub-items are run together without proper separation (e.g., 'p. ...; q. ...; r. ...; s. ...; andt. ...', 'andk.', 'h.' attached to 'g.', 'l.' attached to 'k.', 'andm.', 'andj.', 'andd.', 'andc.', 'andb.'). This risks downstream boundary splitting and list association.

Minor meaning drift/terminology: 'ketentraman, ketertiban, dan pelindungan Masyarakat' is better rendered as 'public tranquility, order, and community protection' (not just 'public peace, order, and protection').
Scrambled numbering/list structure: Article 11 paragraph (2) marker appears inline with page number ('24 - (2)') instead of as a separate list item following (1).
Meaning drift/incorrect cross-reference: Article 16 refers to 'Article 13 paragraph (2) letter d' but the original refers to Article 12 paragraph (2) letter d.
Minor meaning drift: 'victim-based decisions' should be 'decisions based on the victim' (keputusan berdasarkan korban).

Scrambled/merged list markers with text: several sub-items are concatenated (e.g., "in the form of:a.", "ande.", "andc.") instead of appearing as separate list items a.–e. and c. in the correct structure.
Numbering structure error in Article 26: paragraph (4) is merged into the end of item k. and not presented as a separate numbered paragraph "4." in sequence.

Minor meaning drift/terminology: "lingkungan hidup" should be translated as "living environment" (environmental affairs) rather than just "environment" in this legal context; also keep consistent phrasing across Article 21.
Scrambled numbering/list structure in Article 30: paragraph (2) is merged into paragraph 1 instead of being a separate list item "2."
Scrambled list marker in Article 30(3): "may take the form of:a." should be separated so that "a." is a distinct list item following the introductory clause
Minor meaning drift/terminology: "Peraturan Wali Kota" should be rendered consistently as "Mayor Regulation" (not "a Mayor Regulation")
Scrambled numbering in Article 30(1)–(2): original has '(2)' embedded after (1) in same paragraph; translation split into separate items, altering list-marker structure required downstream.
Minor meaning drift in Article 30(2): 'maupun' should be 'as well as' (inclusive), not 'or' (alternative).
Punctuation/termination missing: Article 30(4) should end with a period (legal drafting consistency).

Scrambled/merged list structure in Article 10: letter items are run together on one line and letter f is missing (original jumps from e to g, but translation must preserve the same marker sequence; also h–k are merged after a page marker).
Meaning drift in Article 10 point g: 'persetujuan (konfirmasi)' should be 'approval/consent (confirmation)', not 'confirmation (confirmation)'.
Minor meaning drift in the header: 'PENJELASAN ATAS' is better rendered as 'ELUCIDATION ON' rather than 'ELUCIDATION OF'.
Meaning drift: "fitrah dan kodratnya" translated as "nature and destiny"; should be rendered as "nature and role/condition as ordained" (not "destiny").
Meaning drift/grammar affecting meaning: sentence about PPT institutions starts with "Which" and loses the subject; should clearly refer to the centers/institutions having the duties and functions.

Meaning drift: "keputusan berdasarkan korban" translated as "victim-based decision"; should be "victim-based decision-making" / "decisions based on the victim" (principle that decisions are based on the victim's consent).
